title: King William's War
text:
King William's War was the North American theater of the Nine Years' War (1688–1697). It was the first of six colonial wars fought between New France and New England along with their respective Native allies before France ceded its remaining mainland territories in North America east of the Mississippi River in 1763. 
It is also known as the Second Indian War, Father Baudoin's War, Castin's War,  the Mournful Decade, or the First Intercolonial War.
